findings.title: knowledge_status is a source-grade mapper, not a field/mechanism-specific knowledge admission interface
findings.source_contract: DEV01_DATA_BASELINE.md: knowledge_status(field_or_mechanism, mode, version) must expose evidence source, semantics, Native/read proof vs research/hypothesis, applicability and unknowns.
findings.actual: Function knowledge_status(source_grade=None,*,observed=False) maps only three grade literals and ignores field/owner/mode/build/version/source conflict. It cannot evaluate a requested field or mechanism under a specified game/version context.
findings.risk: Downstream DEV02/03 consumers cannot distinguish version-specific knowledge admissibility from generic source-grade labels; incomplete DEV01 required result, not an observed Native safety violation.
findings.requested_remediation: Reuse existing field catalog and provenance, add a minimal field/mechanism-specific knowledge-status query or clearly scoped equivalent that returns field ID, exact source, mode/build applicability, qualification, conflict and UNKNOWN; keep original helper as low-level grade mapping. Add positive/negative field/mode/version tests; do not build parallel registry.
findings.acceptance: Public caller can ask supported/unsupported field in two contexts and receive distinguishable source/provenance/UNKNOWN, including cross-mode/version refusal.

findings.title: coverage_report has aggregate counts only; empty observation families disappear from missing coverage
findings.source_contract: DEV01_DATA_BASELINE.md: coverage_report(save,batch) should expose domain/field coverage, gaps, inaccessible/restricted parts and freshness; not just existence of schema field.
findings.actual: Report contains NOT_OBSERVED/STALE/WITHIN_REQUESTED_AGE totals, list of fact unit IDs and a constant restricted_fields='WITHHELD'. It does not enumerate the missing/stale field identifiers or report empty family/absent badge dataset as a domain gap. Exact traversal logic reproduced for an empty player_badge_values=[]: NOT_OBSERVED=0 with zero units.
findings.risk: False impression of adequate field/domain completeness, and weak ability to direct next capture/research. No evidence of leaked private data.
findings.requested_remediation: Extend current baseline report to source-linked per-domain/per-field presence, missing or unknown, staleness and safe restricted-field policy labels (not hidden private field values). Explicitly classify absent/empty families and distinguish NOT_OBSERVED from not applicable. Include tests empty badge family, mixed-unit and withheld/suppressed coverage.
findings.acceptance: Report identifies concrete missing/stale fields and an absent badge family; counts remain consistent and do not disclose owner-restricted raw data.

findings.title: Synthetic flag and mode allow contradictory labels
findings.actual: synthetic=True with FAST_SIM or synthetic=False with SYNTHETIC passes validation. Result still refuses causal proof, but representation is ambiguous for later mode-separated learning evidence.
findings.requested_remediation: Either validate synthetic flag/mode consistency, or represent source simulation kind separately from target/hypothetical mode and test each invalid combination.
findings.acceptance: Output does not label genuine FAST_SIM game evidence as synthetic or synthetic arithmetic as real game observation.
